"milkV" is silkscreened on board top and "Duo_256M_V1.0" on board bottom. {{See also|Milk-V|List of SBCs}}
Available Duo USB & Ethernet IOB exposes 4x USB 2.0 ports :and 1x 100M Ethernet in a ''Raspberry Pi B'' format.
===Links=== *[https://www.cnx-software.com/2024/02/13/duo-256m-compact-sbc-sg2002-multi-architecture-soc/ ''Duo 256M is a compact SBC based on SG2002 multi-architecture SoC'' on '''CNX-Software'''] *[https://www.hackster.io/news/milk-v-drops-the-unusual-sophgo-sg2002-into-an-upgraded-ai-ready-duo-development-board-e60d12b9ec8b ''Milk-V Drops the Unusual Sophgo SG2002 Into an Duo Development Board'' on '''hackster.io''']
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''SophGo'' SG2002 @1.0GHz (selectable) :SoC: 64-bit RISC-V C906 or ARM (Cortex-A53), :64-bit RISC-V C906 @700MHz, MCU 8051 @300MHz :NPU: 1.0 TOPS *Storage: TF card (max.128GB)/MMC card slot, *Memory: 256MB (DDR3) RAM (integrated SiP) *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet port (via 5x I/O pins) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) port *GPIO: 2x 20-pin headers *Power Source: 5V via USB (Type-C) port
